subject: history
concept: Understanding that photos, objects, and stories can tell us about the past (simple primary sources)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines an old object or photo (real or illustrative) and describes what it tells them about the past
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an old photo to a clue about what life was like then
exercise.abstract: Student explains what a described old object or photo reveals about the past

misconception_flags: treats an old photo/object as having no informational value about the past

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
